51602.name: Nathanos Marris' Coin

51603.flavor: Already, I've a kingdom in my prospects, a land to rule. What to ask for? Perhaps a frozen scone...

51604.name: Speedy's Gold Coin

51606.name: Felicia's Silver Coin
51606.flavor: Style is a way to say who you are without having to speak.

51607.name: Sinrek's Silver Coin
51607.flavor: Live and let live or die trying.

51608.flavor: Some days, I think the murlocs don't appreciate everything I do for them.

51609.name: Barthilas' Copper Coin
51609.flavor: I wish … I wish Patricia would always be near me!

51611.name: Eitrigg's Copper Coin
51611.flavor: Whatever comes, the Horde will endure. It must!

51612.name: A Peasant's Silver Coin
51612.flavor: I'm so forgetful! I wish I had a better memory. Wait, didn't I already throw a coin into here?

51614.name: Medivh's Silver Coin
51614.flavor: I know how it will all end… I only wish I knew how to lessen the burden.

51615.name: Muradin Bronzebeard's Silver Coin
51615.flavor: May the Holy Light protect us on our expedition to the frozen north.

51616.name: Fandral Staghelm's Silver Coin
51616.flavor: The War of the Shifting Sands... I wish I could forget it ever happened.

51617.name: Tyrande's Coin
51617.flavor: That I might protect those I hold dear, and continue to reflect the grace and light of Elune.

51618.name: Malfurion's Coin
51618.flavor: Were we too late to stop the Nightmare?

51619.name: Uther Lightbringer's Gold Coin
51619.flavor: Young Arthas must learn patience to temper his power. I will pray that he one day learns how to lead with care rather than force.

51620.name: Anduin Wrynn's Gold Coin
51620.flavor: I wish I would grow up, it feels like I've been 10 for years.

51621.name: Tirion Fordring's Gold Coin
51621.flavor: It is my wish that my dear Taelan will grow strong enough to defend the people he cares for.

51622.name: Alonsus Faol's Copper Coin

51624.name: Lady Katrana Prestor's Gold Coin
51624.flavor: Listen, little wishing fountain. You'll give me all your power if you know what's good for you.

51625.name: Princess Calia Menethil's Copper Coin

51626.name: Private Marcus Jonathan's Copper Coin
51626.flavor: I wish to grow a glorious, bushy mustache someday.

51628.name: Torta's Gold Coin

51629.name: Aurelian's Silver Coin

51641.name: Momo's Coin

54000.name: Azure Frog

54001.name: Dream Frog

54002.name: Bullfrog

54003.name: Infinite Frog
54003.flavor: A peculiar frog that seems to defy the laws of time and space, hopping effortlessly between dimensions.

54004.name: Poison Frog
54004.flavor: Beware the vibrant hues of this deadly amphibian, as its skin secretes a potent toxin capable of incapacitating even the mightiest of foes.

54005.name: Snow Frog
54005.flavor: Native to the frigid regions of Azeroth, this hardy frog has adapted to survive in icy environments, its azure skin camouflaging it against the snowy landscapes.

54006.name: Pink Frog
54006.flavor: "Delicate and enchanting, this rare frog species captivates with its vibrant pink hue, believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to its owner."

54007.name: Golden Frog
54007.flavor: Legend has it that this shimmering amphibian is a harbinger of wealth and abundance.

54008.name: Pond Frog

55027.name: Snowpeak Eagle

55034.name: Grim Batol Mountaineer Pauldrons
55034.flavor: Haven't been used for a long time

55077.flavor: <Rumored to be an imitation of Lord Jorach's wedding gift to his late wife.>
